title: Executives
description: Check your organization's digital performance and risk at a glance.
detail: One clear view of compliance, accessibility, and performance across your entire web portfolio — the summary you need before board meetings, budget reviews, or public scrutiny.
job: You're accountable for digital performance you can't see day to day. ScanGov turns accessibility, security, and performance into a scorecard you can act on, not just monitor.

items.title: One dashboard for every site your organization runs
Grades and trends that translate technical issues into risk
A record you can point to before a board meeting or public scrutiny
No manual audits or waiting on IT for a status update

title: Digital service teams
description: Monitor, track, and improve website health at scale.
detail: Continuous scanning across your entire web portfolio. Accessibility, security, and performance issues surface in a prioritized task list so your team fixes what matters most.
job: Your team can't fix what it can't see across dozens of sites. ScanGov finds every issue and turns it into a clear, prioritized list — not a pile of raw findings.

items.title: A single prioritized tasklist across every site and indicator
Issue reports developers can act on immediately
GitHub integration so issues flow into your existing workflow
Continuous scanning, not a once-a-year audit

title: Third-party vendors
description: Demonstrate compliance and performance to clients.
detail: A verified, shareable compliance record that proves digital standards are being met — building client trust and simplifying renewals.
job: Clients want proof you're meeting the standard, not just your word for it. ScanGov gives you a public, verifiable scorecard that does the convincing for you.

items.title: A shareable public scorecard clients can check anytime
A dated changelog that shows steady improvement, not just a snapshot
A built-in feedback loop that builds trust with the people you serve
One less thing to explain at contract renewal

title: Government leaders
description: Get executive visibility into agency digital performance and compliance.
detail: Real-time compliance and performance data across all your websites — so you can report progress, spot risk, and decide without waiting on manual audits.
job: You're responsible for digital performance across agencies you don't manage day to day. ScanGov gives you the visibility to ask the right questions before problems become public.

items.title: Real-time compliance and performance data across every agency site
Grades and trends you can report on without waiting for IT
Early visibility into risk, not just after-the-fact incident reports
One shared standard across every team and vendor

title: Website managers
description: Identify and fix issues before they impact visitors.
detail: Around-the-clock monitoring with alerts for new issues before they affect users — so you can prioritize fixes and show measurable progress.
job: You find out about problems when a user reports them or a browser flags them. ScanGov catches accessibility, security, and performance issues before they become someone else's complaint.

items.title: Around-the-clock monitoring with alerts on new issues
A status bar showing exactly how many pages still need work
Every issue exportable to CSV, JSON, or Markdown for your team
Clear, prioritized fixes instead of a wall of raw data

title: IT staff
description: Automate scanning and integrate performance data into your workflows.
detail: API access and automated scanning that fits your existing workflows — compliance and performance data flows into the tools your team already uses.
job: Manual scans and one-off audits don't scale across dozens of domains. ScanGov automates the scanning and plugs the results straight into the tools your team already uses.

items.title: API access for scanning and results, not just a dashboard
Single sign-on through your existing identity provider
Automated URL management that stays in sync as sites change
On-demand rescans whenever you ship a fix

title: Hosting providers
description: Prove the value of your hosting environment with verified data.
detail: Independent verification of the performance, security, and compliance of your hosted sites — credible third-party data that proves the value of your infrastructure.
job: Customers judge your infrastructure by the sites running on it. ScanGov gives you independent, verifiable data that shows exactly how well those sites perform.

items.title: Domain-level dashboards for every site you host
Independent, third-party verified performance and security data
A changelog that documents improvement over time
Data you can point to in renewal conversations, not just claims

title: Procurement officers
description: Evaluate and enforce digital delivery standards across vendor contracts.
detail: Objective, verified data on whether vendors are meeting digital requirements — so you can write standards into RFPs and hold vendors accountable at renewal.
job: RFPs set a digital standard, but there's rarely a way to check whether a vendor actually meets it. ScanGov gives you objective, verified data to write into contracts and enforce at renewal.

items.title: Objective scores you can set as a contract requirement
A public scorecard vendors can't dispute or fake
A changelog that shows whether performance improved or slipped
Feedback data that surfaces problems before renewal, not after

title: Oversight offices
description: Track digital compliance across agencies and identify systemic issues at the portfolio level.
detail: Compliance and performance data across multiple agency websites — so you can identify patterns, prioritize reviews, and report on government-wide digital health.
job: Spotting systemic problems across dozens of agencies takes more than a spot check. ScanGov gives you portfolio-wide data so you can find patterns, not just one-off findings.

items.title: Compliance and performance data across every agency site at once
Trends over time, not a single point-in-time snapshot
A shared standard for comparing agencies fairly
Data that supports a finding, not just an impression
